entities.summary: Samara Rodrigues de Almeida is a Brazilian female volleyball player. With her club Sollys Nestlé Osasco she competed at the 2011 and 2012 FIVB Volleyball Women's Club World Championship. She was elected the Most Valuable Player of the 2009 FIVB Volleyball Girls' U18 World Championship.
